the mungbean genotyped PMB 27 and PMB 5 were found to be the most resistant genotypes against mungbean leaf crinkle virus and root rot, respectively.
the 20 mungbean geno-types viz; PBM-27, PBM5, PBM-11-2, ML-682 and MH-309 possessed combined resistance against mungbean Yellow mosaic virus, Anthracnoses, leaf crinkle, and root rot.

the 46 mung bean genotypes evaluated in the present study possessed resistance to at least one of the four diseases viz. mung bean yellow mosaic virus, mung bean anthracnose leaf crinkle virus and mung bean root rot.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of mungbean genoypes resistant to the major diseases affecting mungbean in Bangladesh.

the screening of 46 genotypes of mungbean against four diseases, viz., mungbean yellow Mosaic virus (MYMV), anthracnose caused by Colletotrichum lindemuthianum, root rot caused by Rhizoctonia solani and leaf crinkle virus (LCV).
the development of a set of mungbean genotypic lines with resistance to the most prevalent mungbean diseases.

the genotypes PMB 27 and PBM-5 possessed resistance to all four diseases, viz. mungbean yellow mosaics virus, anthracnoe, root rot, and leaf crinkle virus.
